subject.title: fix(msteams): strip internal tool-trace banners from outbound text

question: Should this external PR wait for real Microsoft Teams transport proof, or should maintainers explicitly override that gate and accept mocked delivery-boundary coverage?
rationale: Repository policy requires real after-fix behavior proof for external non-docs PRs; only a maintainer can authorize an exception when Teams credentials are unavailable.

options.title: Require live Teams proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted Gateway/Bot Framework log, copied live output, or Teams transcript showing banners removed and trace-only delivery suppressed.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: Explicitly accept the delivery-pipeline tests as sufficient despite the untested real Microsoft Teams transport hop.

recommendation.title: Require live Teams proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted Gateway/Bot Framework log, copied live output, or Teams transcript showing banners removed and trace-only delivery suppressed.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged sibling-channel replacement established both this sanitizer boundary and the stronger transport-proof standard.
